completed_minute_law.decision_time_t: right edge of completed interval (t-1 minute,t]
completed_minute_law.option_feature_cutoff: event/source timestamp at or before t; canonical completed-minute state stamped t
completed_minute_law.index_context_cutoff: completed index/context state stamped t-1 minute
completed_minute_law.buy_execution: BUY committed after tensor t fills only from completed-minute t+1 executable ask
completed_minute_law.exit_execution: EXIT committed after open-state tensor v fills only from completed-minute v+1 executable bid
completed_minute_law.descriptive_path_start: strictly after entry fill e=t+1; first mark is t+2

current_entry_quote_requires: ask greater than or equal to bid
both legs belong to the same completed-minute state
tplus1_entry_fill_requires: finite positive ask at exactly t+1
quote_completeness_and_freshness.no_tplus1_ask: committed candidate is not executable and has no valid realized-entry label
quote_completeness_and_freshness.future_no_bid: zero option value for path labels; never forward-fill or substitute an earlier bid

opening_and_reconnect_law.reentry_unlock: 15 new consecutive complete canonical minutes with complete ladder and synchronized context
opening_and_reconnect_law.open_position_during_reset: new entries blocked; dedicated open-contract record remains active for HOLD/EXIT and protective flattening

market_context_axis.note: The market axis contains only contract-invariant values. Right-dependent alignment flags, D-family surface values, and E-family Greeks are contract-axis fields.

signed_alpha_channels.name: vwap_side_alignment_flag
signed_alpha_channels.formula: 1 for call when gap>0 or put when gap<0; else 0

signed_alpha_channels.name: omar_side_alignment_flag
signed_alpha_channels.formula: 1 for call when omar>0 or put when omar<0; else 0

signed_alpha_channels.name: momentum15_side_alignment_flag
signed_alpha_channels.formula: 1 for call when momentum_15m>0 or put when momentum_15m<0; else 0

signed_alpha_channels.name: D.near_atm.side_smile_slope_bps_per_5pt
signed_alpha_channels.formula: nearest finite same-right slope of quantized_mid/spx*10000 versus offset, scaled to 5 points

signed_alpha_channels.name: E.bs.delta
signed_alpha_channels.formula: Black-Scholes delta from exact slot quantized mid, spot, strike, right, and time to 16:00 ET

signed_alpha_channels.name: E.bs.gamma
signed_alpha_channels.formula: Black-Scholes gamma from exact slot quantized mid, spot, strike, right, and time to 16:00 ET

ft2_20_legacy_field_crosswalk.purpose: Freeze semantics for every field named by the reviewed V1 [90,19] market-history plus [90,42,4] contract-path layout while documenting the repaired, nonduplicative tensor axis.
ft2_20_legacy_field_crosswalk.global_e_family_resolution: No contract-free E-family Greek is permitted. E.bs.delta and E.bs.gamma are computed once per exact source-neutral contract identity and stored once on the repaired contract axis. The V1 internal_delta/internal_gamma aliases point to those same values; they are not duplicate model channels.

synthetic_acceptance.required: historical and live builders independently reproduce every exact field, identity, mask, and timestamp in each vector
